englishTranslation: Roasted veal with rice paper rolls
atAGlance: Bê thui cuốn bánh tráng is rare veal wrapped at the table, usually with rice paper, herbs, green banana, star fruit, and fermented mắm nêm, a funky fermented anchovy dip.
whatItIs: Bê thui cuốn bánh tráng is the roll-it-yourself version of Quảng Nam-style veal: rice paper, herbs, green banana, star fruit, and mắm nêm around tender slices of veal.
howToEnjoy: Layer veal, herbs, green banana or star fruit, and noodles if served into rice paper, then dip lightly in mắm nêm. The fresh sour pieces keep the veal bright.
howLocalsOrder: Order bê thui cuốn bánh tráng when you want the full wrapping setup. Ask for extra rice paper, extra herbs, or nước chấm if fermented mắm nêm is too strong.
worthKnowing: This is central Vietnamese roll culture at its clearest: meat is only one part of the bite; herbs, sour fruit, rice paper, and fermented dip complete it.
goodToKnow: Build the roll before judging the veal: herbs, green banana or star fruit, rice paper, and a careful touch of mắm nêm are what make the bite complete.
commonOptions: nước chấm instead of mắm nêm

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bê thui cuốn bánh tráng.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of roasted veal with rice paper rolls.
